messages:
carla: spotted a pattern where api keys minted by the partner bridge arrive with project_id unset and show up in the org fallback bucket. Causing quota and dashboard noise.

mike: saw spikes in quota alerts around 04:00 UTC, could be same. Any trace ids?

carla: trace=tr_4b2a, sample log: `2026-04-02T04:01:12Z auth: exchange ok token=tok_x project_id= project_source=partner-bridge`

neha: short term: map empty project_id to 'orphan-internal' before quota routing and mark as non-billable. Long term: enforce claim validation in exchange.

mike: agree. I'll add a Prom metric auth_orphan_count and a dashboard tile. Prom example: `sum(rate(auth_orphan_total[5m])) / sum(rate(auth_requests_total[5m]))`

infra-bot: ticket INF-2026-907 created for projectless attribution; assignees: mike, neha

carla: add console flag to notify affected org admins when orphan_pct > 0.5% for 1h. Also include an opt-in backfill action.

neha: will sketch UX copy and PR for policy change. mike: can you own the alert and metrics?

mike: yes. will canary patch to staging and sample 1% of orphan traces for manual review.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled auth-router:v2.4-canary -> staging at 2026-04-02T12:00:00Z

carla: thanks all, will follow up with runbook and billing guard to avoid accidental charges.
